run_ENorm_training: run the ENorm training loop on CIFAR-10 with configurable epochs, batch size, and learning rate
run_train_function: run the train function to perform one epoch of training with SGD and optional ENorm regularization
run_test_function: run the test function to evaluate model accuracy and loss on a test data loader
review_AverageMeter_class: review the AverageMeter class that computes and stores average and current values for metrics
run_adjust_learning_rate: run the adjust_learning_rate function to decay the learning rate using a linear or quadratic schedule
